subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Vocabulary development and Time to Talk: a place I would like to visit / Oman quiz and the dolphin centre narrative
outcomes: Learn and use new words like canyon, trek and awesome
Describe a place you would like to visit
Answer quiz questions about Oman and read a narrative

tf.s: 'Trek' means to go on a long, difficult walk.
tf.why: Yes, a trek is a long, hard walk.

tf.s: A canyon is a long deep valley with steep sides.
Oman's coastline is less than 1000 kilometres long.
tf.why: Oman's coastline is over 3000 kilometres long.

tf.s: Oman borders Saudi Arabia, Yemen and the UAE.
In a quiz show, the host is the person who answers the questions.
tf.why: The host asks the questions; contestants answer.

tf.s: 'Wildlife' means only pets kept at home.
tf.why: Wildlife is animals and plants living in nature.

tf.s: In Time to Talk, you describe a place you would like to visit.
tf.why: Yes, you make notes and then talk about it.

tf.s: A narrative essay tells a story of events.
tf.why: Yes, like the text about the dolphin centre.
'Proud' means feeling pleased about something good.

tf.s: A contestant is the person who writes the quiz.
tf.why: A contestant takes part in the quiz.

boxes.q: Which animal is NOT found in Oman?
boxes.why: The quiz says bears are not found in Oman.

boxes.q: Why should you take notes before speaking?
o: They help you remember your ideas

boxes.q: What type of essay is the dolphin centre text?
boxes.why: It tells the story of a visit.

o: We trekked up the mountain for five hours.
boxes.why: You trek on foot over a long distance.

o: I am proud of my brother's success.
She was proud because she lost her bag.
He felt proud of breaking the window.
boxes.why: We feel proud of good things.

boxes.q: When did Bahla Fort become a UNESCO heritage site?
boxes.why: Bahla Fort joined the UNESCO list in 1987.

boxes.q: How far is Masirah Island from the mainland?
boxes.why: Masirah is 15 kilometres from the mainland.

hunt.q: Travel to discover a new place
The person who runs a quiz show
A person who plays in a quiz

o: Saudi Arabia, Yemen and the UAE

mcq.q: According to the quiz, which animals are found in Oman?
mcq.why: Bears are the animals not found in Oman.

mcq.q: What do partners do in the Oman Quiz activity?
o: Ask Quiz A and B questions and give scores out of 10
Write a letter to a teacher
mcq.why: Partners quiz each other and give a score.
Bahla Fort is on the UNESCO heritage list.

mcq.q: Choose the best word: The view from the top of the canyon was ___.

o: We want to explore the old fort and its rooms.
I explore my breakfast every morning.
She explored her homework into the bag.
mcq.why: We explore places to discover them.

mcq.q: Your friend says: 'I'd like to visit Jebel Shams.' Which follow-up question is best?
mcq.why: An open question gets more details.

mcq.q: The text tells what happened on a visit to a dolphin centre. Why is it a narrative essay?
o: It tells a story of events
It gives arguments for and against
It describes a product for sale
It is a letter to a friend

mcq.q: Oman's coastline is over 3000 kilometres long. What does this suggest for tourism?
o: Oman has many coastal places to visit
mcq.why: A long coast offers many beaches and sea activities.

mcq.q: Why is it useful to guess a word's meaning from context first?
o: It helps you understand new words while reading
It means you never need to read
mcq.why: Context clues help you read faster and better.
